publicName: A US returns and fulfilment operator
summary: Five websites and a lead pipeline wired into Google Sheets for a multi-site fulfilment business.
challenge: A fulfilment operator running several sites needed each one presented properly and every enquiry landing somewhere the team could actually work from.
approach: Designed and built five websites under one consistent standard, so the group reads as one operation rather than five unrelated pages.
Wired lead capture straight into Google Sheets with tracking, giving the team one place to manage enquiries without new software to learn.

results.label: Efficient lead management via Google Sheets
